shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- configs ---'; for f in next.config.*; do [ -f \""'$f" ] && { echo "### $f"; cat "$f"; }; done; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- next docs matches ---'; rg -n -i \"partial.?pre.?render|ppr|cacheComponents\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- relevant docs ---'; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '(cache-components|partial-prerender|ppr|caching)' | sort; printf '%s\\n' '--- cache config doc ---'; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---'; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductList.tsx app/Recommendations.tsx; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 5 \"Prerendering|Suspense|fetch\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md | sed -n '1,240p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- migration config constraints ---'; rg -n -C 4 \"route segment|dynamic|revalidate|runtime|Suspense\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
@@
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- final status ---'
git status --short
printf '%s\\n' '--- task diff ---'
git diff -- next.config.ts tsconfig.json"
